approval: explicit user instruction: Freeze B4/E8, then run held-out validation
data_population: 2023 complete-case respondents in development countries; missing responses are not imputed
eligibility: all six worry and seven original harm-domain responses substantive; equivalently all 20 derived features observed

transfer_plan.assignment: nearest frozen centre; first stored centre on an exact tie

conclusion_rules.broad: defining response contrasts remain recognizable without widespread deterioration in representation quality
conclusion_rules.decision: analytical synthesis; no automatic numerical transfer score or undeclared cutoff
conclusion_rules.partial: recognizable profiles coexist with identifiable profile/country-specific semantic or assignment-quality limitations
conclusion_rules.poor: substantial loss of defining patterns or widespread deterioration in representation quality

transfer_plan.distance_flag: nearest distance > frozen assigned-profile development weighted p95
transfer_plan.profile_identity: all original categories; three largest positive development category-vs-outside contrasts per profile are fixed descriptive anchors
transfer_plan.regional_k2: diagnostic only; not a final rich regional typology

uncertainty.interpretation: variation over the observed held-out countries; not worldwide population or fitting uncertainty
uncertainty.within_country: preserve relative survey weights among complete cases

global_stability_caution: B has stronger whole-partition and reference-profile recovery; E meets ARI benchmarks but pooled cluster Jaccard lower tails are weak and must be reported
other_old_frozen_artifacts: older course_artifacts/week04_frozen_profile_model.joblib and processed/*heldout*k3 are not this B/E analysis
prior_screen: at least four observed worry and four harm domains is reported; complete-case rule is stricter and determines assignment
profile_ids: preserved exactly from existing reference caches; not relabelled by prevalence
regional_limitations: local structure not universal; k2 only diagnostic; several smaller E profiles have weaker recovery; global/local ARI is not a retention or significance test

transformation: recode top category, divide by top, subtract respondent mean in six worry coordinates, append mean; multiply both by sqrt(alpha/6); harm by sqrt((1-alpha)/14)
weights: relative WGT within included complete-case country; equal total influence per included country, separately within each split
